editPolicy.liveBody: Most updates publish instantly. Changing what buyers search on always gets a quick review — and if you change what the property fundamentally is (property type, locality, BHK, or buy vs rent) it comes off search until we approve it again. Price, furnishing and possession stay in search while we re-check them.
editPolicy.reviewBody: Your listing is still under review, so your edits will be checked along with it.
editPolicy.publishInstantlyDesc: Description, amenities, availability, deposit, address details & new photos.
editPolicy.needsRecheckDesc: Price, furnishing & possession — re-checked while your listing stays live. Property type, locality, BHK, buy vs rent & removing verified photos come off search until approved.
editPolicy.offSearchNote: These change what the property fundamentally is, so your listing comes off search while we re-check it — usually within 24 hours.
editPolicy.staysLiveNote: Your listing stays live and searchable while we re-check these — buyers can still find it and contact you.

verifyNudge.title: Stand out — get your Verified badge
verifyNudge.body: Verified owners rank higher in search and earn buyer trust. As a thank-you, your first verified listing gets a free 7-day Featured boost. It's optional and takes about a minute via DigiLocker.

modal.startOverBody: This clears every detail you've entered — including photos and documents — and returns you to a blank form. This can't be undone.
modal.identityTitle: This looks like a different property
modal.identityBodyPost: , which makes this a different property rather than an update to your existing one. Keep your current listing as it is and post this one separately. Your free listing stays yours — additional listings need an Owner plan.
modal.dupBodyPost: — we matched it by its address and electricity meter. Publishing it again would create a duplicate, which hurts your reach and buyer trust. Edit or renew your existing listing instead of posting a new one.
